artworks.title: Still Water, Early Light
artworks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a high-resolution artwork to hang in a 3D fine-art museum, one original work for the vocabulary word "serene".
Subject: A wide, utterly still lake at dawn, pale mist suspended above the water, a small willow leaning from the bank, and distant wooded hills reflected in soft blue and gold. The unbroken reflection and tranquil spacious composition embody calm, peaceful and undisturbed.
Style/medium: A luminous impressionist oil painting, a cohesive series titled Light & Living Things. Sophisticated broken brushwork, visible impasto and linen grain, diffused natural light, sage and olive greens, muted ultramarine, warm ochre and touches of soft ivory. Atmospheric, observational, painterly and carefully composed; nuanced tones rather than sugary or saturated colors.
Composition: one square artwork, flat straight-on reproduction, the painting fills the entire image edge to edge. Design a complete, considered composition with detailed areas that reward looking closely at large display size.
Output: high-resolution square, target 2048 by 2048 pixels or the highest supported square resolution.
Constraints: only the artwork itself. No picture frame, gallery wall, typography, letters, word labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, sticker borders, panels or grids. Do not imitate a named living artist. Avoid clip art, emoji, children's flashcard aesthetics, bland stock imagery and plastic CGI rendering.
